caption: Tunnel-mode ESP in the worked example's order. A router on the Internet reads only the outer header 203.0.113.2 → 198.51.100.9; the inner 10.1.1.5 → 10.2.2.7 and TCP port 443 travel encrypted, and the green block is the integrity check computed over the ESP header, inner packet and trailer.

spec.title: ESP tunnel packet
spec.aria: A tunnel-mode ESP packet in order: new outer IP header from 203.0.113.2 to 198.51.100.9, ESP header carrying the SPI and sequence number, the encrypted inner packet from 10.1.1.5 to 10.2.2.7 on port 443, the ESP trailer, and the ESP authentication data.
